title: An Agent-based Model to Evaluate Interventions on Online Dating Platforms to Decrease Racial Homogamy
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspect of faith or religion. The focus is on racial homogamy.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings concern interventions to reduce racial homogamy on simulated online dating platforms.
